about: Triad Drift ENG-35 fallback music. Original compositions rendered by scripts/td_music.py. MIDI note numbers (57 = A3).

sounds.name: Music_Combat
sounds.note: Combat bed: 128 BPM, 32 bars = exactly 60 s, A minor (Am F C G, two bars each). Four 8-bar sections build: drums + bass + arp, then snare + pad, then the lead, then everything; a snare fill and riser lead back to the top. Seamless loop.

sounds.name: Music_Intro
sounds.note: Intro bed, played once: an A drone opening over 34 s, a slow pulse from 10 s, a rising arpeggio from 20 s, a swell into one hit at 34 s (the hand-over to wave 1) and a ringing A minor ninth chord. 40 s.
